author: 송예찬

sourceClips.name: Sprint
sourceClips.adaptation: 72 arm, hand and finger curves adapted from Forward walk and retimed to the sprint cycle; retains source torso and legs. Not original unarmed mocap.

derivedEntry: Reversed, ground-aligned Stand clip; preserves humanoid curves.
transitions: Existing controller: Standing and Crouching sub-state machines. Crouch Enter -> directional blend tree or forward Sprint -> Exit. Crouch Sprint requires IsMoving, IsSprint, IsCrouch and MoveY > 0.001. Existing standing bool-driven logic is preserved.

blendController.standing: 1D Speed: Idle at 0, Walk at 1, Run at 2
blendController.crouching: 1D Speed: Idle at 0, nested 2D directional Walk at 1, Sprint at 2
blendController.speedUnits: Normalized animation amount, not metres per second. Values between 1 and 2 blend walking and running.
blendController.runtimeContract: Presenter resolves sprintInput && moveInput.y > 0 for both Motor and Animator, including forward diagonals. SetLocomotion receives the Motor's accepted IsCrouching; blocked standing keeps the crouched animation. Speed and direction are damped; Animator itself does not enforce sprint eligibility.
blendController.interruptionSource: Destination, allowing the reverse posture transition without restarting the source transition
blendController.pending: User feel/art review. Jump, landing and pickup input/action timing remain separate work.

runtimeChanges: PlayerPresenter forwards accepted Motor posture and common movement/sprint state
PlayerLook smooths the existing eye-drop target
inputAndCameraAndCollider: Existing C toggle, height/center changes, clearance check and movement settings retained. Only animation delivery and eye-height interpolation were connected on the user's explicit request. Physical input devices were not disabled.

validation.scope: Playable preview checks plus 28 live Play Mode cases using an isolated prefab instance and temporary paired virtual keyboard/mouse. Real C/WASD/Shift action callbacks, posture transitions, speed blending, ceiling refusal and rapid toggles verified. Player scene and B2 inherit the saved prefab controller. Final pose renders inspected; no full playthrough claim.

reviewPending: Two user subject concept images located in the flow and reviewed in SourceAssets/PlayerSubjectReview. They depict different subjects, not two views of one model. No subject mesh generated or inspected. Recheck retargeting and floor alignment after avatar replacement; final animation art approval remains pending.
tooling: SourceAssets/PlayerCrouch. Creation/import tools are historical and must not be rerun blindly: some reset trims or assume the old root state layout. Verify.cs validates the existing controller; VerifyBlend.cs validates the separate draft. Reports: verification.json and blend_verification.json.
